items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: Bonnie Bigard, Johnny Donnells, the same thing.

ctx.x: Yeah. Johnny Donnells. Bonnie Bigard, Johnny Donnells, the same thing. And yet still the BAM system is supposed to be the, well, which is a developed system, and you have several ways of making a passage of notes, more so than you had with the.

It's a little easier for trills and a lot of fast work you can do better on it. I guess it's better in tune. Yes, that's right. But did you ever think, did you ever try the BAM? Did you play the BAM much?
